MTLFXFrameInterpolatorDescriptor.doc: A set of properties that configure a frame interpolator, and a factory method that creates the effect.

MTLFXSpatialScalerDescriptor.doc: A set of properties that configure a spatial scaling effect, and a factory method that creates the effect.

MTLFXTemporalScalerDescriptor.doc: A set of properties that configure a temporal scaling effect, and a factory method that creates the effect.

MTL4FXSpatialScaler.doc: An upscaling effect that generates a higher resolution texture in a render pass by spatially analyzing an input texture.

MTLFXSpatialScaler.doc: An upscaling effect that generates a higher resolution texture in a render pass by spatially analyzing an input texture.

MTLFXSpatialScalerBase.doc: An upscaling effect that generates a higher resolution texture in a render pass by spatially analyzing an input texture.

MTLFXTemporalScaler.doc: An upscaling effect that generates a higher resolution texture in a render pass by analyzing multiple input textures over time.

MTLFXTemporalScalerBase.doc: An upscaling effect that generates a higher resolution texture in a render pass by analyzing multiple input textures over time.

MTLFXSpatialScalerColorProcessingMode.doc: The color space modes for the input and output textures you use with a spatial scaling effect instance.

MTLFXSpatialScalerColorProcessingModeHDR.doc: Indicates your input and output textures use a high dynamic range color space.

MTLFXSpatialScalerColorProcessingModeLin.doc: Indicates your input and output textures use a linear color space.

MTLFXSpatialScalerColorProcessingModePer.doc: Indicates your input and output textures use a perceptual color space.

+supportsDevice:.doc: Queries whether a Metal device supports frame interpolation.

+supportsMetal4FX:.doc: Queries whether a Metal device supports frame interpolation compatible with a Metal 4 command buffer.

-newFrameInterpolatorWithDevice:.doc: Creates a frame interpolator instance for a Metal device.

-newFrameInterpolatorWithDevice:compiler.doc: Creates a frame interpolator instance for a Metal device.

+supportsDevice:.doc: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether the spatial scaler works with a GPU.

+supportsMetal4FX:.doc: Queries whether a Metal device supports spatial scaling compatible with Metal 4.

-newSpatialScalerWithDevice:.doc: Creates a spatial scaler instance from this descriptor’s current property values.

-newSpatialScalerWithDevice:compiler:.doc: Creates a spatial scaler instance for a Metal device.

+supportedInputContentMaxScaleForDevice:.doc: Returns the largest temporal scaling factor the device supports as a floating-point value.

+supportedInputContentMinScaleForDevice:.doc: Returns the smallest temporal scaling factor the device supports as a floating-point value.

+supportsDevice:.doc: Queries whether a Metal device supports denoising scaling.

+supportsMetal4FX:.doc: Queries whether a Metal device supports denosing scaling compatible on Metal 4.

-newTemporalDenoisedScalerWithDevice:.doc: Creates a denoiser scaler instance for a Metal device.

-newTemporalDenoisedScalerWithDevice:com.doc: Creates a denoiser scaler instance for a Metal device.

+supportedInputContentMaxScaleForDevice:.doc: Returns the largest temporal scaling factor the device supports as a floating-point value.

+supportedInputContentMinScaleForDevice:.doc: Returns the smallest temporal scaling factor the device supports as a floating-point value.

+supportsDevice:.doc: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether the temporal scaler works with a GPU.

+supportsMetal4FX:.doc: Queries whether a Metal device supports temporal scaling compatible with Metal 4.

-newTemporalScalerWithDevice:.doc: Creates a temporal scaler instance from this descriptor’s current property values.

-newTemporalScalerWithDevice:compiler:.doc: Creates a temporal scaler instance for a Metal device.

depthTextureFormat.doc: The pixel format of the input depth texture for the frame interpolator you create with this descriptor.

distortionTextureEnabled.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the frame interpolator supports barrel distortion correction.

inputHeight.doc: The height, in pixels, of the input motion and depth texture for the frame interpolator.

inputWidth.doc: The width, in pixels, of the input motion and depth texture for the frame interpolator.

motionTextureFormat.doc: The pixel format of the input motion texture for the frame interpolator you create with this descriptor.

outputTextureFormat.doc: The pixel format of the output color texture for the frame interpolator you create with this descriptor.

outputWidth.doc: The width, in pixels, of the output color texture for the frame interpolator.

requiresPrevColorTexture.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the frame interpolator requires the client to provide a previous color texture.

uiTextureFormat.doc: The pixel format for the frame interpolator of an input texture containing your game’s custom UI.
